text:
marie: Quick sync — we need a field-ops SLA handshake for the Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant connector bundle before marketplace listing. Top open items: on-prem hardware staging windows, regional spare inventory, P1/P2 response targets (hosted/dedicated/private differences), and an indemnity/data-handling blurb for the listing. Kickoff doc: <https://redwood.internal/partners/connector-field-ops-runbook>.

ajay: From eng: proposal -> Hosted/Dedicated: 2h P1 response, 4h P2. Private (customer-managed infra): 4h P1, 8h P2 escalation to SEs. We can provide pre-configured images and quantization profiles. Need FieldOps for physical swaps SLA.

ben: FieldOps note: we can commit to 24h on-site swap for SFO/ORD/AMS if spares are staged, 48h for SIN (APAC) unless we pre-stage there. Shipping SLA options: ground 48h, air 24-36h. Recommend staging hubs: SFO, AMS, SIN. :truck:

sara: Marketplace/product: we also need to lock an embargo date and exact "compatible models" list for the listing metadata (quant profiles, max context, recommended batch sizes). Legal flagged the telemetry wording — @toni can you advise on the indemnity + data handling paragraph?

toni: I'll draft a limited indemnity covering hardware failure and connector-induced data exposure for the marketplace listing. Need partner countersign for staging hardware custody. Also want a short sentence requiring partners to follow our telemetry redaction guidelines. Will circulate a draft by Wed EOD.

ajay: Two engineering asks to include in the runbook/listing: 1) allowed model variants (e.g., llama2-13b, redwood-compat-quant-8) 2) an ops flag controlling automatic fallback to CPU-only for private infra (to avoid cascading failures). Add those to the doc.

ben: Ops playbook excerpt (for the runbook):
```
# connector recovery smoke test
1) curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || fail
2) run ./tools/ingest-smoke --sample=1000 --timeout=300
3) if errors >5% -> escalate to eng oncall, collect /var/log/redwood/connector.log and `docker inspect` output
```

deploy-bot: preflight-check | staging -> 8/10 tests passed. DB migration tests failing on databricks adapter. Tagging @ajay for triage.

marie: Action items recap: 1) @toni draft indemnity + telemetry clause by Wed 2) @ben confirm staging hubs + spare counts (SFO/AMS/SIN) + shipping SLA options 3) @ajay update runbook with model compat list and CPU-fallback flag 4) @sara lock marketplace embargo date by Fri. Check-in Thursday 10am PT. :calendar:

sara: confirmed — locking embargo for next Thursday unless legal blocks.

ben: will confirm spares by EOD tomorrow.

ajay: I'll triage the migration tests now.

toni: on it, will send draft Wed AM.

marie: great — thanks everyone. If we want a dry-run we can schedule a staged failover next week. :thumbsup:
